author: Shadowbladz
body:
Played in SpaceMonkeyMafia, making the OCN tourney's invatationals twice in a row. 
Been considered for Impact, Loading... and Instant Crash (was going to join before it disbanded).
Been given an open invite to Turquaars.

Mainly a bow player, strong frontliner but can play any position in DTM.
GMT timezone.
Fairly active.
Feel free to check out my youtube channel (TheShadowbladz) to get a grasp of my skill
